reason: Provides agent-controlled conversation span compaction with required self-written checkpoints and optional local archival of the replaced raw span.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供按选定对话范围压缩上下文并写入检查点的工具，同时可将被替换的原始内容归档到本地。
summaries.en: Provides an agent-controlled tool for compacting selected conversation spans into written checkpoints, with optional local archival of the replaced raw content.

capabilities: Allows an agent to select and compact a conversation span into an agent-written checkpoint
Archives the raw compacted span to a local spill artifact when autoArchive is enabled
Replaces selected conversation content and related tool messages in the active session
